title: Ibyagurishijwe
description: Cunga ibicuruzwa wagurishije ku isoko ry’igerageza.

paymentHeldDescription: Amafaranga yishyuwe n’umuguzi abikwa kugeza ibicuruzwa bigejejwe aho bigomba kugera. Ubwikorezi bufungurwa ku giciro gikalkuliwe na Pinza.

packagingConfirmedInTransit: Byemejwe ko ibicuruzwa byapakiwe. Ubu biri mu nzira.
